title: Shared cognitive components across tasks
disposition_reason: The source implements genuine metadata-to-unseen-map prediction with simultaneous person/family exclusion and two same-feature references. It does not freeze a primary metric or issue authentic support/target custody. The prospective primary below requires a versioned execution binding before results.

scientific_target.question: Do training-derived shared cognitive components predict a new task-family map for a held-out person better than a rank-matched direct semantic-to-map ridge model?
scientific_target.known_answer: Held-person, held-task-family measured statistical response maps on independently selected spatial support; a dictionary fitted to that target map is not a prediction.
scientific_target.answer_origin: IBC original contrast maps joined to an independently reviewed endpoint taxonomy, map geometry and design metadata.
scientific_target.case_unit: One person × declared endpoint map, within a held task family.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Biological person with shared endpoint/task-family dependence; overlapping fitted folds are dependent.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Cross-person and cross-task-family response prediction from allowed design semantics; shared components are a predictive representation rather than discovered causal cognitive primitives.
exclusions: No target-map coefficient fitting described as unseen-task prediction.
No scientific significance, paper reproduction or native execution claim from invented four-value map controls.

inputs: Training-person/training-family maps and independently declared endpoint descriptions/design coefficients.
Train-only text vocabulary/IDF and design-term transform shared across component/full-rank/rank-matched arms.
forbidden_inputs: Held-person or held-family maps at any fit/selection stage.
Target-informed voxel support, coefficient estimation, ontology revisions or target descriptions containing observed map results.
observation_contract.case_identity: Declared complete population has13 people × 51 endpoints = 663 dispositions; endpoint IDs map to a frozen task-family taxonomy and authentic source/support identities.
observation_contract.split: Outer fold excludes both held person and held family globally; nested selection shrinks only permitted outer support. Missing training/query cases are explicit ineligibility, not silently recovered from excluded support.
observation_contract.coverage: All663 case dispositions and all three arms retained. Complete authentic map census and independently issued support remain absent; engineering fixtures use invented four-value maps and one eligible fold.

primary.name: Shared-components minus rank-matched-ridge signed map-correlation gain
primary.aggregation: Prospective selected endpoint: per-case signed Pearson map correlation difference, equal endpoints within task family, equal families within person, then equal13-person mean; complete paired support required.
primary.rationale: Tests benefit of the shared representation against a competent same-feature, same-rank alternative without rewarding target-map reconstruction. This descriptor chooses the future primary; current source summarize still returns primary_metric=None.

secondary: Full-rank-ridge comparison; map MSE and MAE direction-aligned gains.
All case dispositions, missing-support reasons and convergence diagnostics.
Per-person/family effects; report undefined correlation and incomplete panels without pooled replacement.

comparators.name: Rank-matched ridge
comparators.inputs: Same train-only semantic/design features and allowed training maps
comparators.procedure: Implemented low-rank direct regression with rank matched to shared-components arm; independently tuned within allowed nested folds.

comparators.name: Full-rank ridge
comparators.inputs: Same features and equal-training-person mean maps
comparators.procedure: Implemented direct ridge comparator; avoids attributing benefits merely to regularization or reduced capacity.

nuisance_controls: Common independently selected map support and geometry for predictions/targets; candidate support cannot authenticate itself.
All feature transforms, components, rank and ridge tuning are training-local, with global person/family exclusion.
Preserve negative component gains and convergence failures; endpoint taxonomy cannot change after outcomes.
evaluation.uncertainty: Current source provides balanced descriptive effects and leaves inference pending. Future primary protocol must freeze participant-cluster uncertainty with family dependence and multiplicity for companion contrasts;663 maps are not663 independent participants.
evaluation.failure_policy: Validate whole immutable prediction batch before any target read. Retain every ineligible/failed case; any unpaired/undefined cell makes the complete pooled effect absent rather than shrinking its denominator.

implementation.scorer_target: evaluation.py independently consumes held maps after complete prediction commitment and computes map correlation/MSE/MAE versus two references; no published-paper scalar matching.
implementation.delivered_scope: Scientific prediction/evaluation and arbitrary-agent operator source plus invented engineering controls; genuine support issuer, protected target reader and selected scientific primary remain external.
missing: Bind the prospective primary endpoint and inferential rule into an executable selected protocol; current source returns no primary decision.
Admit authentic endpoint taxonomy, geometry, inputs, references and protected/native execution.
implementation.execution_evidence: Preserved package explicitly limits controls to invented four-value maps, one eligible fold and inert native-owner double; no actual scientific result is inherited.

direct_observation.representation: This task predicts unseen neural maps from task design metadata and training maps; the protected query map is an output.
direct_observation.boundary: Presenting that map for direct interpretation changes the registered target.

typed_viewer.representation: A viewer of protected query maps would leak the response being predicted.
typed_viewer.boundary: Any separate viewer interpretation task needs a distinct known-answer question and observation boundary.

tool_assisted.representation: The delivered operator captures one fixed Programme and runs fresh held folds; it supplies no participant-facing per-case adaptive actor or numerical/model tool loop.
tool_assisted.boundary: No target-dependent support or coefficient fitting; independently commit complete predictions before protected evaluation.
missing: Implement and audit an actual per-case investigation actor/controller and tool transport; fixed submitted-programme execution cannot be relabeled as this mode.

frozen_program.representation: Scientific programme implements nested component and direct reference fits.
frozen_program.boundary: Freeze methods and protocol before query responses; method improvements remain allowed within equal observations and split.
missing: Native/environment qualification and scientific primary binding

summary: Specify genuine joint person/family generalization instead of target-map dictionary reconstruction.
Select a prospective correlation-gain primary against rank-matched ridge and expose that runtime primary binding is still missing.
Retain all 663 dispositions and source evidence limits.
Final access audit marks tool_assisted not_delivered: submitted fixed-programme outer-fold execution does not implement per-case agent/tool investigation; frozen programme source remains available.
revision.source_review: Inspected actual evaluation/model/split/feature source and retained operator guide; official IBC code checked.

evidence.supports: Preserved registered scientific objective, source citations, original admission boundaries and prior construction review.
Complete663 dispositions, invented controls and unqualified native/source boundaries.
Target-consuming map scorer, exact complete-support aggregation and absent primary metric.
Actual shared-components and two direct ridge alternatives.
Global person/task-family holdout and training-only nested selection.
Origin of fMRI contrast maps; the prospective semantic-to-unseen-map bridge is this benchmark implementation, not an author-supplied unseen-task predictor.
admit_programme requires one fixed Programme and run_candidate launches owner.run_fresh for each prepared held fold; this is frozen programme execution source, not an adaptive participant actor.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: No direct-observation, viewer or new model trial is established by this source review. Historical engineering controls retain their original scope; the four historical neural programme attempts concerned NEURAL-007 and NEURAL-077, not this task.
excluded_claims: No target-map coefficient fitting described as unseen-task prediction.
No scientific significance, paper reproduction or native execution claim from invented four-value map controls.
